faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Dharmaketu is 3 (ruling planet Jupiter). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Dharmaketu?
faq.a: Thursday is the traditional association for Dharmaketu. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Dharmaketu?
faq.a: Yellow Sapphire is the traditional association for Dharmaketu. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Dharmaketu?
faq.a: Yellow, Gold are the traditional associations for Dharmaketu. These are interpretive.
